翻译有很大的问题，不改的话就一直差评。比如“飞行游览”的原本效果是“如果这回合已经丢弃过卡牌的话，能量+1”，汉化硬生生翻成“在这个回合丢弃卡牌时，能量+1”。以及“迟暮”那一套属于翻译第一次看80%会理解错误 对于首次游玩对战的简中/繁中玩家，建议调成英文或者日文游玩。英文翻译基本正确（至少玩的时候能理解，有的中英文文本指代不明通病想一下也能理解），日文我不会，不过貌似没有反馈有误的？ 说实话，希望制作组找个国内的ll翻译组，翻译成果不被ban代搞掉的话我觉得不少翻译组会挺乐意搞的（甚至可能会无偿？） Need better Chinese Translation. I believe many translation groups in China dedicated to Lovelive or LLSS are willing to do this job. The down vote will remain until Chinese Translation has been greatly improved.

I like Roguelike Deckbuilders. I like Yohane. I like comfy games. So surely I'd love this comfy roguelike deckbuilder game ft. Yohane, right? Well, seeing the positive reviews really did give me some hope. [h1] Gameplay [/h1] The gameplay feels barebones and relics give you the illusion that they actually do something when they just do "+5 Shield on turn 2", or "Attack does +1 damage" or even weirder "this card in particular does +1" which is pitiful compared to how fast enemies can scale and twerk on you. This makes card synergy hard to come across other than the rare 1 + 2 card combo every other turn. Small Nitpicks for those who care: When using cards, you can't queue up another card so it leads to this clunky loop of 'play card, wait for animation, play, wait' rinse repeat. Targetting with cards is also unorthodox as well. Please take a look at one of the battle screenshots on steam. You can't drag your attack card to the enemy's avatar. You have to instead click a card then the enemy's HP bar top right. [h1] Story and Fanservice [/h1] Oh well at least the fanservice is serviceable, right? I'm not so sure about that. Some of Yohane's animations are really cute and polished but if you were expecting any voice acting past chapter 1, you'll be disappointed. Characters do the RPG classic of grunting or saying words every time a new piece of dialogue shows up, which is fine for less important events; but when the boss of a chapter, be it Dark Hanamaru or Ruby, doesn't have any voice acting, you can't help but roll your eyes just a tad bit. [h1] Conclusion (TL;DR) [/h1] I was expecting more given the Very Positive rating on steam and the $29.99 price tag, however I'm heavily disappointed with what I've seen. Even as a game that puts fanservice first, it fails to provide that. The gameplay is nothing to write home about but that's to be expected. If you're still interested in purchasing this, I'd hold out for when it goes on sale for $10-$15 ish. I know that's what I'll be doing.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/31028489-Maddmike/]Maddmike Steam Curator[/url] https://youtu.be/SdVdZOrC_Fg You’ve played deckbuilders that have you upgrading cards, but how many of them showcase your protagonist lovingly admiring their new glowing card in full 3D glory? Yohane the Parhelion does not look or sound like conventional deck builders. Its origins as a multimedia anime IP give it different priorities than other card systems, and that’s its best and worst quality. You get a lively cast that bounds onto the screen mid combat. You get an action camera that showcases your card duels in dynamic ways. You even have some minor Yugioh influence—the cards are not some abstraction but they literally exist in the world, and your hero draws and plays them with appropriately dramatic key posing. Yet these presentation flairs often feel like they’re the game, rather than supporting one. The deckbuilding gameplay itself is a near 1:1 recreation of the genre's patron saint “Slay the Spire”, but it fails to copy the build diversity and tight balance that was core to that experience. It leaves Yohane feeling like model viewing software with a deckbuilding component, rather than a worthwhile anime card game in its own right. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3167561434 Yohane is a game that you beat. Though there’s technically an infinitely playable deckbuilder postgame, there’s a very discrete final boss and credit roll moment somewhere around the six hour mark. The challenges on the path to those credits aren’t curated enough to be a satisfying campaign, though—it takes a single roguelike run and chops it into pieces to sell an illusion of length. If you imagine a conventional roguelike with three acts and a smaller fourth boss act, Yohane’s campaign chapters consist of doing act 1, then starting a new run to do acts 1 and 2, then a new run to do acts 1, 2, and 3, etc. It retreads so much of the same ground and for something so short it stings a little harder. That length would have been easier to swallow if the card battles were more robust and the meta progression more compelling, or even if it just tied those duels back to interesting antagonists. Yohane conveniently leans on an ‘inverted-bad-guy’ setup where all of the major enemy bosses are mirror world flips of our heroes, rather than unique characters that could have taken advantage of the tangible 3D space and narrative focus that Yohane’s style affords them. There’s still a feelgood story here, it’s just too predictable and too uneventful to carry the modest deckbuilding components for all but the largest fans of the property. In each run, you start with a basic assortment of simple strike and defense cards, one card unique to one of the two classes, and a starting charm (a permanent run-wide passive bonus) in alignment to the costume you’re wearing. The charms are rarely a tactical needle mover. You easily exceed twenty or more in a given run, and they almost always give minor incremental bonuses you can ignore, rather than anything you can shape a strategy around. Their relative insignificance removes an entire axiom of decision-making that’s present in the games that Yohane is borrowing from. The actual deckbuilding and cards themselves are pretty comparable to the genre standard: you’ve got balanced builds, discard builds, you’ve got your shield slam builds, and a small handful of others. There’s nothing “wrong” with any of them and yet there’s nothing all that right, or especially interesting, with them either. It’s just the most vanilla implementation of these things and, for me, it doesn’t clear the depth or breadth threshold I’d need for something so basic to pull me away from the games it’s evoking. Even the “summoning” system, where you bring in Yohane’s friends to give you mid-fight boons, are just consumables under another name. They serve the same short term function, they’re acquired in the same way (randomly mid run), and they’re not strong or consistent enough to alter build strategy despite how visually iconic and cool they are. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3167560737 The meta progression stinks too. Your cross run currency is pulled in a lot of directions, and a lot of those directions are boring. The chance for higher complexity and more interesting cards dropping in your future runs is something you must purchase rather than automatically acquiring—in other words, you need to buy the fun parts. But those fun purchases are in competition with basic health upgrades (that you have to re-acquire independently for each build, by the way), and even the costumes! I thought half the appeal of this game would be the dress up, and yet their prohibitive cost makes them more of a post-game treat rather than something you can efficiently buy along the way—unless you’re okay with sacrificing builds and power for them. It’s a shame that nothing on the gameplay front resonated with me because there’s so much about this concept I enjoy. “Slay the Spire at home” isn’t such a bad idea when “home” is this comfy little anime village. The characters are expressive and lively during the card encounters, and it’s fun just to stare at your menu-home-base and watch the camera pan around your character, friends, and acquired costumes. Yet the actual game here is too shallow and its progression too dull; making the six hour duration feel painfully long. [h2] In Conclusion [/h2] Yohane the Parhelion: Numazu in the Mirage is a minimum viable deckbuilder buttressing an animation showcase. Those animations do provide the title with a flair and beauty this genre seldom gets, but they don’t salvage its uninteresting card system and stretched campaign. Those seeking to combine their love of this property and their love of deckbuilders would be better served by watching the anime on a second monitor while playing anything else. 当满手基础打击防御却在二层是遇到第一个首回合无视防御打20的普通小怪时，就可以想象游戏的平衡性并没有经过精细的计算。 游戏基础是杀戮尖塔，但是游戏性，丰富性，重复游玩性不足杀戮尖塔的一半。大部分遗物缺乏实用性，删卡手段稀少，根据抓牌的运气让游戏难度呈现出极端两极分化，伙伴技能过于强力，加血上限的遗物没有作用的bug，伙伴槽满了无掉落的愚蠢设计等等。 即使作为粉丝向游戏，配音不全，角色互动不足，没有足够养成要素也足够诟病了。 虽然确实是最二次元的爬塔游戏，但作为这个价格来说，制作团队也的确没有认真对待自己的作品。

Overall I enjoyed the game but I am not recommending it because of the price, get it when its on sale. There were enough cards so that it didn't get to repetitive, you get to see different cards depending on which deck style you decide to pick in the beginning of a run. Took me about 10 hours to beat on normal and that is me failing 2 runs only, so if you are good at card games or play on easier difficulty you might beat it faster. You get currency at the end of each run to mainly spend on hp upgrades. You can buy cards but you don't start with the new cards it just means you can get them in your run and you can also buy costumes which slightly alter your starting deck. Only 2 cons. The game gives you 2 play styles balance and and power style. I wish they had more play styles. I don't think the price point is worth it, better to get it on sale. Inscryption is more then half the price of this game and gives more play time.

I would only recommend this game if slay the spire is too difficult for you. Else i cannot recommend it with slay the spire existing. Having many hours in slay the spire the idea of an anime version of the game sounded amazing. It is very cute and has some unique mechanics with summons replacing potions and a few card keywords. And cute unique events. Which despite a lot of the relics and cards having a 1 to 1 translation it still feel like they went and build on the mechanics. Even if a lot of it felt like a reskin of slay the spire. Where my issues arise is in the balance. Where slay the spire has a meticulous risk reward and managing your hp. This game seems to have significantly reduced enemy hp and way easier to get shield(block) and damage out. Playing it on the hardest difficult mode (which is normal) I have yet to even need to consider healing at a rest. There is a lot of reward in nodes for little to zero risk. Elites feel hardly any dangerous than normal encounters and in some instances even less. Further taking away a lot of risk for more reward. And chest not being spread out over the lanes feels like an oversight with 2.5 to 20 times the gold of an encounter and a charm for free. Further more , the main way the game does end up doing damage to you feels bad. Even if the damage tends to be completely irrelevant, frequently you're being dealt unavoidable damage in the form of debuffs that start of your turn. Or the few instances where you draw badly on turn 1 into enemies having huge damage. And the other time is when enemies put debuffs that you seem to only be able to stop if you happen to get 1 specific potion that locks you out of all your spells or attacks. Often doing so on turn 1. Taking away agency. And this happens quite frequently , taking many turns where the player can take little to no action making the game slow down to a crawl making it feel tedious. (In sts , there is an enemy with the debuff to stop attacks but its rare and you get plenty of opportunity to counter it. ) It has a cute little anime story in between but that feels far and few between in the mostly tedious feeling game play making it hard to recommend for people that want to enjoy the story. Making me unable to recommend it for neither people looking for Deckbuilding rogue like game play nor the anime part. Taking StS but tweaking things without seemingly taking the player experience into account.

Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE is a roguelike deckbuilder made with very heavy inspirations from slay the spire. A lot of enemy/card/relic/map designs were taken directly from slay the spire. The game does not make any real attempts at innovating on the formula and in many cases made design decisions that made the gameplay experience worse. Status effects that stop you from playing a category of cards as well as attacks/status effects that deal damage to you through block, I personally found these mechanics to be very frustrating to play against with little to no counterplay. The game's UI also leaves much to be desired, with playing cards during combat feeling jerky and awkward, and checking your relics/cards while traveling on the map being a real chore. The one thing that the game hits out of the park is the voiceacting and visuals. The main protagonist and all the supporting characters have very good 3d models coupled with fluid and expressive 3d animations. All of the cards also come with very cute art. For those who came to play a deep and innovative roguelike, know that there isn't anything new here that you can't experience in slay the spire. Though the visuals and voicework are undeniably excellent and went a long way towards making my 7 hours of gameplay more enjoyable, underneath this brightly colored and meticulously crafted exterior is a deeply derivative and mediocre gameplay core.

[h2]It's literally Slay the Spire.[/h2] [b]I got this game from a bundle and would never recommend it full price. It's a sloppy imitation of Slay the Spire, with the Love Live IP slapped on top. I have 100+ hrs in this game, but you will pretty much experience all this game has to offer within the first couple of runs. I completed the main objective after 8 or so hours and was held hostage until the final achievement popped.[/b] [b]Gameplay - 5/10[/b] - You start off with a hand of basic cards and assemble a more powerful deck by collecting rewards after each fight/event. You can complete quests during your run, rewarding you with currency that can purchase upgrades to strengthen your deck for future runs. - The entire system is nearly identical to the one in Slay the Spire. The starting hand is the same, the damage/shield numbers are the same, and even the map is the same. Rest spaces allow you upgrade your cards or heal a percentage of your health- just like in Slay the Spire. - Unlike in Slay the Spire, the bosses in this game don't feel that unique. None of them really have any special mechanics and they mostly just do the same thing. - There's not that many cards overall, which results in only a few possible deck combos. Repeated runs stale quickly. [b]Story - 0/10[/b] - The story is pretty much just a set of pointless dialogue between characters. I'm not personally a fan of Love Live so I just couldn't get invested. I skipped everything past the first two scenes and I doubt I missed much. [b]Graphics - 8/10[/b] - The character models look great and their animations are really expressive. I just wished that the card artwork was a bit more stylized instead of just generic anime dribble. [b]Achievement Hunting - 0/10[/b] [133.7hrs] - The vast majority of this game's achievements will unlock just from playing five or so runs normally, but there is ONE achievement that is completely RNG- requiring you to complete every 'quest' at least once. The quests are on a random rotation. Completed quests get cycled out for a randomly selected one and it doesn't prioritize the quests you haven't done before. It took me an extra 100 hours to roll the last quest I needed for completion.

仿杀戮尖塔的模式，不过有所不同。整体而言还是比较推荐大家尝试的，蛮优秀的休闲小游戏。 + 剧情、配音、人物角色好评（虽然剧情蛮白开水的，但是配音很好的弥补了这点） + 召唤卡蛮有意思的，而且这玩意儿是黏手的，意味着囤积了个小技能 + 完成委托无疑是增加了可玩性，让玩家去解决委托完成各种各样的小挑战，比一味爬塔多了一点点新乐趣 - 最核心的，卡牌构筑和遗物设置，肯定不算差，但是也并没有感觉特别好。主要是杀戮尖塔珠玉在前，再对比时往往感觉难以超越，有个比较高的期待值。但是实际上也是很不错了，几章下来玩的还是蛮开心的。 - 内容还是有点少了，卡牌和遗物还是有可拓展开发的空间。 —————————— 260205拓展： 按商店介绍：“《幻日夜羽》是《Love Live!》系列第二部 《Love Live!Sunshine!!》的官方衍生作品。” 可惜我对LL了解的不能说是非常熟悉吧只能说是啥也不知，不过作为非粉丝游玩也毫无影响，很简单的剧情，并不复杂的人际关系。 但是，有配音而且配音相当优秀很好的弥补了剧情的白开水，听着配音很有感觉，气氛给足了。 不过很遗憾，战斗内的部分没有实现全语音，仍有缺少。 再就是游戏的核心，爬塔打牌。 抄的内容不少，高情商点就是，玩过杀戮尖塔会很容易上手。 卡组卡牌、遗物、事件、商店、休息……太熟悉了，就是套了个不同的外壳。 比较好的一点是，确实有那么点不同，比如说： 召唤卡召唤角色，有登场技和监控全场的其他技能，作为buff的形式存在而非角色存在，三个回合后退场。登场技而言，回血增防过牌加体基本含盖全了，在场技有点吃运气看你是否有用到相关的卡。召唤卡会在战斗后掉落，开局黏手始终可以在任意回合使用，不过注意如果开了自动回合结束而且确实除了召唤卡无可执行操作的话，会自动结束不给你用召唤卡的时点，所以请务必提前用或者关闭自动结束回合（我个人不建议关，因为自己结束蛮累的，工作量累计的话可不少） 遗物有副词条，比如金钱获取量增加、卡牌buff。算是个小添头吧，有时候碰巧了也是有用的。 不太好的地方整体而言还是能忍受的，或者说在这样的缺点下我觉得仍不失一款值得一试的小游戏： 最严重的数中文翻译问题，有些描述的翻译不太合适。不过经历过之后也不难理解，毕竟游戏的框架就这样了。 抄了，但是抄的有限。虽然内容已经不少了，但是还是觉得不够。仅以我目前刚完成一周目为例，内容的重复度还是蛮多的。比如因为三层塔使得房间数较多，事件遗物反复出现见过的，太眼熟了。而即使是解锁服装也只是初始略有不同，都还是杀戮尖塔战士流。 另外，不得不说第一层实在是有点坐牢，二三层还算不错。比较逆天的就是上来就安排个偷钱的，第一回合偷第二回合就跑路，初期想打掉减少损失不是那么容易的，很气人。不过总体来说稳扎稳打一遍过是没问题的，除非最后肝成就，基本上不需要反复刷就能推完剧情。 操作逻辑方面，鼠标玩有点别扭，手柄很舒服，即使是纯用键盘我觉得也比纯用鼠标好用……所以，或许steam deck体验不错？（我没试，我是无线手柄玩的） 总之，开开心心的还是能收获很不错的休闲时光~

People who like the original series that this game is a spin-off from might like having an adaptation into a new genre, and it copies plenty of decent elements to be a good on-boarding to deckbuilder roguelikes, with lower difficulty options for anime fans unfamiliar with the genre. Also a main story that has you start with act 1, and slowly adds 2, 3, and 4 in subsequent runs. Losing a game, ever, is enough for most casuals to ragequit, so I can see the logic. But for veterans of the genre... If you've played literally any other roguelike deckbuilder, just skip this one. It's a mediocre adaptation of Slay the Spire. Everything good is 1-to-1 from Slay the Spire, and nearly every new element just feels awful. It's easy and frustrating, there's no higher difficulty, only lower ones. You'll be bored out of your mind almost managing to perfect a boss, then in one turn get a status that blocks you out of one card type for multiple turns. Either no attacks for 2-3 turns while inflicted with poison, or locked out of every card that's not attack. No skills, no powers. Have a deck based around 'have only skill or only attacks in hand'? Yea lose half your hp without being able to act. And when that doesn't happen, its too easy to sweep through the enemies because hp doesn't scale past act 1, only enemy damage goes up. Relics are 1-to-1 from Slay the Spire, almost no new ones. The two new ones are basically bugged and break the game in half; there's an extra copy of the 'play attacks get +1 stat' that triggers at 4 attacks. And two relics that give shield each time you play an attack. And relic damage/shield scales off your own stats. So if you just attack spam, you get free stats and block to the point that combat is no longer a challenge. It's so good at building block there's nothing that can really threaten you; even if you only have a single dex-based one, it gets out of hand too fast. 3 attacks, gaining 2-3 block at base... at +2 dex you're getting 12 block, triple that of ornamental fan. And there's a ton of stat-buff relics (almost every relic is a hp-dependent stat-buff or free damage/block on a specific turn). So the 'crisis' relics that give +3 to +5 make you easily sweep the low-hp enemies, or turn the invincible combo on even sooner. The 'unique' twist of relics giving +1 to every copy of a randomly pulled card isn't all that interesting; it barely makes an impact unless you get +1 to your basic block. And events are uninteresting; there's barely any 'remove' events, some are even 'force card pickup' or 'stat buff next combat' that are basically dead weight. You get stuck with your starter cards too often. Curses are here, but all the curse events are rng 'bad outcome' and not something you take intentionally, so they barely come up. And there's no relics based around curses except the 'treasure gives a curse' energy relic. I had curses... twice? And the rest were basically status cards. Even after clearing the main game, there's a boring, boring grind trying to get the achievements. Unlocking new cards (and swapping outfits to change your start of run card, relic, and potion) costs so, so much that you don't get to experiment, and you have to give up the 'free +50 max hp' upgrade chain that is objectively a better use of money. Unlocking one new rare card costs as much as the +20 max hp upgrade. I've seen everything the game has to offer at 5 hours, played for another 6 after beating the main story and didn't enjoy it that much, and I don't feel like grinding for 30 hours to 100% the game. The copy-paste Slay the Spire difficulty achievements 'starter relic only run' or 'one-turn-kill an act boss' are a pain to complete. Animations are also way too slow, and 'disable animation' only disables a cutscene that plays on most rares, and some uncommon cards. It's still a good 5 seconds to play a single card. Just makes the game an annoying slog...

杀戮尖塔动漫版 水水人必买 幻日yohane为背景 战斗场景是3D建模 遗憾的是 人物和场景建模并不出彩 通关难度很低 但是游戏性设计堪忧： 1. 首先是饰品，绝大多数饰品都为“仅第X回合提供X效果” 没有特点，记不住效果也不会在战斗中有意控制效果发动。饰品与卡牌的联动很差，纯数值碾压过去。 2. 卡牌强度梯度和卡组构建不合理。初始卡组和绝大多数蓝卡都不能成为卡组核心或过渡，而金卡单卡强度过高又与其他卡没配合。战斗外卡组构建就是尽可能加费，金牌见了就拿遇火就敲，除了滤抽和金牌能删就删；战斗内就是0费滤抽直到金牌上手。最后莫名其妙大几十伤害直接灌死。前期白蓝卡太弱有策略也高额战损，后期金牌随便打打没有策略可言。赢了，但是完全没有乐趣。 3. UI交互系统半成品。事件拿饰品时不给效果说明；卡牌效果翻译不正确；手柄查看卡组时不能查看升级后效果.... 游戏性和战斗乐趣甚至不如同类型的无尽宇宙:Neoverse，至少人家的天赋是真的能决定卡组流派和玩法，有自己构筑的乐趣。 缺点：杀戮尖塔都做好了 抄作业还抄这么差；DLC地狱差评 优点：至少在认认真真抄作业，没想着自己创新 70/100 个人评分70/70 好想去内浦 好想去淡岛 （至于沼津，人家浦之星学园在沼津吗你就“沼津是水团的故乡”）

[h1][b]幻日夜羽：卡牌游戏[/b][/h1] [b]“哒哒哒哒……Darkness！”[/b] 本作主角是一个占卜师，凭借占卜的名义，动不动做出拿起卡组上方的牌看一眼再放回去，这种在赌场会被黑帮切小拇指的可怕举动。 玩了20小时我才恍然，这不是什么正经的“卡牌游戏”，只是“卡牌”这个类型，相较于其他玩法比较易于IP作品的发挥，画画卡面，配配音就行。换句话说，如果对这IP不感兴趣，那很不推荐入手。若是对这IP有兴趣，那它其实还挺诚意十足的，卖IP之间亦有差距，相比[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836860/Neptunia_x_SENRAN_KAGURA_Ninja_Wars/]海王星X闪乱神乐[/url]，这种单纯是把角色丢进去一通乱炖的好太多 我入手纯粹是因为，这个开发商BeXide的另一部作品[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767170/_/]超级子弹娘[/url]非常好玩！[/b]一看又是它家出的一部卡牌游戏，想说试试看，但是完全看不到前者的影子，无论是机制还是规则上，都不像是同一家制作的，水准和趣味性都相差甚远，令人失望 [h1]说它粉丝向[/h1] 至少对这部作品而言，“粉丝向”并非贬义。超150张牌，绘制还算精心，当然我不懂原IP，所以不晓得是不是直接拿了什么素材图来填卡面的，每张牌都有独立的配音。 整体难度也不高，打五遍过五章畅通无阻。说像杀戮尖塔，差别还是有点大，本作有9个角色，但只是被动效果，初始两张卡不一样，全程使用、获得的卡牌是一样的，不像尖塔那种一个角色一套打法；其次，其实跟尖塔类似的部分也就是，轻度肉鸽地图，左边主角，中下卡牌，右边敌人的UI画面。其他的我觉得是很通用的元素。除此之外，它的护符有附魔效果，除了该固定属性之外，还会有第X回合加攻、加防、造成伤害、强化某张卡等随机属性；再者它有0消耗的召唤卡，召唤其它盟友来助阵3回合，非常强力！ 不过它对路人玩家很不友好，连概括性的介绍都没有，默认玩家了解背景，认识角色。其它倒还好，我比较纳闷的就是，主角是个搓水晶球的占卜师，难道不是靠魔法而是江湖骗子吗？不然她被吸入镜中世界之后会使用魔法了怎么那么兴奋！ [h1]没卡牌模样[/h1] 越玩越觉得不对劲，也正是这篇差评的原因。 [b]——套路单一，[/b]别看卡的种类很多，但其实就一个压缩卡组，能量循环打伤害的打法，什么叠甲、反伤、弃牌之类的都不存在，甚至每局选的卡都大差不差。 [b]——路线太短，[/b]以至于每次卡组快要成型，或者刚一成型的时候就结束了。 [b]——通货膨胀，[/b]每次经过商店删卡的价格都涨一倍，25→50→75→100→125块，这谁删得起啊？尤其是这游戏不知道是不小心还是故意的，所有战斗，小怪、精英、BOSS打完给的钱都是固定的，20块。我看了眼超级子弹娘，那部就是在同一张地图内删卡价格都一样不会涨，而且金币获得绰绰有余。 [b]——规则呆板，[/b]这游戏玩不爽的一部分归咎于基础规则，首先它极其容易一回合抽N卡，但它居然有手牌上限，然后能量用不完，手上卡没了就结束回合了，它家做的另一部卡牌游戏，超级子弹娘是你打完手上最后一张牌，会从卡堆再抽一张，如果0消耗，卡组就一张牌，那你懂的。而本作就没这种说法，牌打完了就结束回合，而且牌没打完结束了也要弃牌下回合重新抽，能玩但是很难受。 [b]——动画拖沓，[/b]另一大部分归咎于无法跳过、快进的动画，每场战斗开场摆pose，各种护符BUFF计算效果、自动往身上堆的动画，结算动画，加起来比我一场出牌的时间还要久，一局时间40分钟，毫不夸张地说能有25分钟以上是耗在各种动画上，这还是我关了出牌动画的前提下。 [b]——交互奇怪，[/b]整个游戏全程鼠标点点点就行，基本遵循一个左键确认右键取消的逻辑，然而你想看某张卡的详情时，需要按键盘的[b]i[/b]。而且鼠标的手感很怪，它好像是偏向键盘、手柄操作，那种一格一格单位选中的，鼠标直接点，经常出差错 除此之外，一些事件设计得也很离谱，别说要动脑子的卡牌，哪怕是它这种无脑的卡牌游戏，遇到什么【获得10张随机卡牌】、【随机删除5张后，获得5张随机卡牌】的事件，9成的人也会一边想着，你想往我的卡组里加什么呀混蛋！一边选择跳过的好吧。 [h1]为难成就党[/h1] 成就党别玩！快跑呀！！ 它有个【所有委托完成一遍】的成就。其中有28个是重复委托，但一次只能接5个，完成一个，再给你一个新的，这就有可能是刚刚完成的。然后比如击杀10只XXX，路过7次商店，还不追溯以往。 我最后遇到的是个击杀10朵花的，我寻思1/28的概率，这不是和怪猎里挖尸体挖出龙玉差不多，人家好像还更低好嘛，深度怀疑它内部是不是有什么游戏时长or局数不够，就死按住某个不进任务池刷新的说法。 社区里更有甚者，100多小时刷不到唯一缺的那个委托，一直是给重复完成过的。也是看了眼社区，才发现，人與人的悲喜果然不尽相同，其他玩家梦寐以求的任务，我天天遇到，顿时看着它们在我的列表里也没那么讨厌了。。。

[h1]Story (-)[/h1] Not really interesting, but since it is not the main selling point at all, I will give this a pass. [h1]Graphics (6/10)[/h1] Character models look good. The rest is ok and the battle animations are a bit lack luster. [h1]Gameplay (6/10)[/h1] My second roguelite game. I had a bit of fun and it was made in a way such that the progess is saved after each story chapter. There are only a few of them and once I beat them all I was done with the game. [h1]Sound (5/10)[/h1] Average. Nothing stood out. [h1]Performance/Configuration/Settings (9/10)[/h1] No crashes. Didn't miss anything [h1]Misc[/h1] Maybe I am missing some context since this seems to be part of a bigger franchise.

Only recommended if buying during a sale. When playing as the main character, Yohane, your progress is saved after each chapter, however if you bought any additional character DLC and play with anyone *other* than Yohane, you will essentially play an arcade game where either you 1-credit clear or fail and start from the beginning. Had checkpointing or at least a Continue screen been introduced it would have saved players hours of gameplay. There is a lack of diversity of backgrounds and BGMs, and enemies do not seem to rotate that often (I have encountered one enemy type twice in quick succession). Battling in the same area and listening to the same BGM all the time does wear me down a little bit. At least, if only there were additional rotating BGMs or backgrounds to keep things fresh. At the time of writing, there is no in-game help option as far as I can see (This may be incorrect.) Personally, it is very disappointing that there is no voice-over (dialogue SFX only) after the first chapter.
